definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun for something long, such as a river, road, coast, or railway, to mean the area running along it.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}{沿|ぞ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: to take a walk along the river

examples.japanese: ⟦{線路|せんろ}→線路：04041_senro⟧{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Cherry trees are in bloom along the railway line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国道|こくどう}→国道：31246_kokudou⟧{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧や⟦ファミレス→ファミレス：11141_famiresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずらり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Along the national highway there is a long row of convenience stores and family restaurants.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}{沿|ぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ドライブ→ドライブ：03866_doraibu⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だった。
examples.english: The sunset was beautiful while we were driving along the coastal road.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{沿|そ}う→沿う：13279_sou⟧ (to run along), with the voicing そ → ぞ after a noun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: along (〜{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧, to walk along)
- 〜{沿|ぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: (the) ... along (〜{沿|ぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧, shops along)
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧{沿|ぞ}い, {海|うみ}{沿|ぞ}い, ⟦{線路|せんろ}→線路：04041_senro⟧{沿|ぞ}い, ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧{沿|ぞ}い, ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧{通|どお}り{沿|ぞ}い

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along; also "in line with" a plan or wishes, which 〜{沿|ぞ}い cannot mean
